title: Omega Men #2 of 6 DC Comics January 2007 Superman Henry Flint Gabrych
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Omega Men #2 of 6 (January 2007), DC Comics. Written by Andersen Gabrych, art and cover by Henry Flint, with Superman on the cover. $2.99 cover price.

Back cover: 2007 Dodge Caliber ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
